newsitem.title: USA: US stocks mixed at opening, Dow moves higher.
newsitem.headline: US stocks mixed at opening, Dow moves higher.

text.p: U.S. stocks were mixed in the first few minutes of trading, with the Dow Industrial climbing even higher after hitting its third consecutive all-time high close on Friday.
The Dow was up 10 points at 6,320, but the S&P 500 opened a shade down at 730 points. The Nasdaq index pulled 0.5 points into the plus zone at 1,258 after opening slightly off.
The bond market was closed for the Veterans Day holiday.
